remarks:
Rare lakefront opportunity at 269 East Terrace Ave in Lakewood! This 750 sq ft, 1-bedroom home sits directly on the shores of Chautauqua Lake, offering beautiful water views and the chance to create your own lakeside retreat.

The home features a simple layout with a living area, kitchen, and separate bedroom, ready for your vision and updates. While it does need TLC, the true value lies in the unbeatable waterfront location—perfect for renovation, seasonal use, or future investment.

Enjoy direct lake access right from your property, ideal for boating, fishing, or simply relaxing by the water. Located just minutes from local shops, restaurants, and all that Lakewood has to offer, this is a unique chance to own lakefront property at an accessible price point.

Bring your ideas and make this hidden gem your own slice of Chautauqua Lake!
